findings.recommendation: Each customer page view runs 1 query for the orders plus 1 query per order (`SELECT ... FROM order_lines WHERE order_id = $1`), up to 101 round trips per request, growing with the customer's order count and with traffic on a user-facing path. `Db::lines_of_orders(&[i64])` (api/src/db.rs:31, one `WHERE order_id = ANY($1)` query) already exists: collect the order ids, fetch all lines in one call, group them by `order_id` in a HashMap, and sum per order while keeping the orders' `ORDER BY id DESC` sequence. Two queries per request instead of up to 101.
